say:1:1521035001:0.text: Don't block the way! I carry <style="highlight">urgent news</style> for the Regulus!
say:1:1521035001:0.male: Don't block the way! I carry <style="highlight">urgent news</style> for the Regulus!
say:1:1521035001:0.female: Don't block the way! I carry <style="highlight">urgent news</style> for the Regulus!

say:2:1521035002:0.text:
And you have found the Regulus!
Stop running and make your report!
say:2:1521035002:0.source_cn: 别跑了，呼临城的领主就在你眼前！\n有什么军情，快点汇报吧！

say:3:1521035003:0.text: And who's this boy? Out of the way!
say:3:1521035003:0.source_cn: 谁家的小孩？怎么在这胡说八道！

say:4:1521035004:0.text: Move, move, move, get out of the way!

say:7:1521035006:0.text: Look closely—this is the <style="highlight">Regulus' bracelet</style>, my name carved into it.

say:8:1521035007:0.text: My father, Regulus Herennus, made it himself, and every soul in Halia knows his handiwork.
say:8:1521035007:0.source_cn: 这是我父亲赫伦尼亲手刻上去的，所有呼临人都认识他的字迹。

say:9:1521035008:0.text: Now you know who I am.
say:9:1521035008:0.source_cn: 看到它，你就该知道我是谁了。

say:11:1521035009:0.text: Forgive me...! You truly are the Regulus.
say:11:1521035009:0.source_cn: ……丰饶神保佑，您真是领主殿下！

say:12:1521035010:0.source_cn: 对。所以是什么军情？快点告诉我。

say:13:1521035011:0.text: Actually... My order is to take the message to the council.
say:13:1521035011:0.source_cn: 可……我接到的命令是汇报给议事官……

choice_prompt:14:1521035011.text: Actually... My order is to take the message to the council.
choice_prompt:14:1521035011.source_cn: 可……我接到的命令是汇报给议事官……

say:16:1521035015:0.text: A pack of beasts has struck the <style="highlight">outpost at Taothos Rift</style>. They're <style="highlight">calling for reinforcements</style>!

say:17:1521035016:0.text: Reinforcements? Then I'll need Perseus to rally the men.
say:17:1521035016:0.source_cn: 增援？那我得先找到珀尔修斯，让他下令调兵才行。

choice_prompt:18:1521035016.text: Reinforcements? Then I'll need Perseus to rally the men.
choice_prompt:18:1521035016.source_cn: 增援？那我得先找到珀尔修斯，让他下令调兵才行。

say:19:1521035017:1.text: The council... They stripped my direct command over the army.
say:19:1521035017:1.source_cn: 还是因为讨厌的议事官……他们不许我直接给军队下令。

say:20:1521035018:0.text: Perseus supports me, but he can't refuse them on every matter.
say:20:1521035018:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯支持我，但他不能处处和议事官作对。

say:21:1521035019:0.text: Some orders, like sending scouts disguised as Wildborn, he'll carry out without question.
say:21:1521035019:0.source_cn: 我的一些命令……唔，像是让士兵装扮成兽人的样子，混进兽...

say:22:1521035020:0.text: But those are hardly real tactics...
say:22:1521035020:0.source_cn: 不过，那些计谋没派上用场就是了……

choice_prompt:23:1521035020.text: But those are hardly real tactics...
choice_prompt:23:1521035020.source_cn: 不过，那些计谋没派上用场就是了……

say:25:1521035023:0.text: Regulus Abundius, time is short. If you can't send men...
say:25:1521035023:0.source_cn: 领主殿下——！现在哨卡的情况真的很紧急，如果您没办法调...

say:26:1521035024:0.text: Who says I can't? I'm weighing the risks...!
say:26:1521035024:0.source_cn: 谁……谁说我没办法？我正在想呢……！

choice_prompt:27:1521035024.text: Who says I can't? I'm weighing the risks...!
choice_prompt:27:1521035024.source_cn: 谁……谁说我没办法？我正在想呢……！

say:31:1521035026:0.text: Absolutely not. You've proven useful, but you're untrained—and the beast attack sounds serious. I won't have you throw your lives away.
say:31:1521035026:0.source_cn: 不，不行！虽然你们很厉害，但也只是普通人。陪我玩一会儿...
say:31:1521035026:0.male: Absolutely not. You've proven useful, but you're untrained—and the beast attack sounds serious. I won't have you throw your lives away.
say:31:1521035026:0.female: Absolutely not. You've proven useful, but you're untrained—and the beast attack sounds serious. I won't have you throw your lives away.

say:33:1521035028:0.text: You're the Regulus. Why care about your guards' lives?
say:33:1521035028:0.source_cn: ……你是领主，是首领。为什么要顾及护卫的命？

say:34:1521035029:0.text: They're here to serve, live or die.
say:34:1521035029:0.source_cn: 只要你下令，护卫就应该去做。会不会死，和你没关系。

say:35:1521035030:0.text: What? How can you even think that?

say:36:1521035031:0.text: Whether it's the Regulus or a common guardsman, every life is precious.
say:36:1521035031:0.source_cn: 生命很宝贵，所有人都应该珍惜自己的生命。领主和护卫也没...

say:37:1521035032:0.text: And as Regulus, it is my duty to safeguard the lives of my people.
say:37:1521035032:0.source_cn: 倒不如说，因为我是领主，所以更应该珍惜每个人的生命！

say:38:1521035033:0.text: You're not going. There must be another way.
say:38:1521035033:0.source_cn: 总之，我不能让你们去。我肯定能想到其它办法！
say:38:1521035033:0.male: You're not going. There must be another way.
say:38:1521035033:0.female: You're not going. There must be another way.

choice_prompt:39:1521035033.text: You're not going. There must be another way.
choice_prompt:39:1521035033.source_cn: 总之，我不能让你们去。我肯定能想到其它办法！
choice_prompt:39:1521035033.male: You're not going. There must be another way.
choice_prompt:39:1521035033.female: You're not going. There must be another way.

say:40:1521035036:0.text: My master is stronger than Perseus.
say:40:1521035036:0.male: My master is stronger than Perseus.
say:40:1521035036:0.female: My master is stronger than Perseus.

say:41:1521035037:0.text: If you don't believe me, ask him yourself.
say:41:1521035037:0.source_cn: 你不相信的话，就去找珀尔修斯吧。

say:43:1521035039:0.text: Fine... I'm sending my guards <style="highlight">to lead the defense at the outpost</style>.
say:43:1521035039:0.source_cn: 好吧……那我就派遣我的护卫长官<style=highl...
say:43:1521035039:0.male: Fine... I'm sending my guards <style="highlight">to lead the defense at the outpost</style>.
say:43:1521035039:0.female: Fine... I'm sending my guards <style="highlight">to lead the defense at the outpost</style>.

say:46:1521035040:0.text: Regulus Abundius... Are you certain of this order?
say:46:1521035040:0.source_cn: 领……领主殿下，您不是认真的吧？！
say:46:1521035040:0.male: Regulus Abundius... Are you certain of this order?
say:46:1521035040:0.female: Regulus Abundius... Are you certain of this order?

say:47:1521035041:0.text: Yes, I trust them with my life. Now, lead the way!
say:47:1521035041:0.source_cn: 我相信我的护卫长官。快带路吧！
say:47:1521035041:0.male: Yes, I trust them with my life. Now, lead the way!
say:47:1521035041:0.female: Yes, I trust them with my life. Now, lead the way!

choice:39:0:1.text: I know exactly what I'm asking.
choice:39:0:1.source_cn: 别担心，我会一点战斗技巧
choice:39:0:1.male: I know exactly what I'm asking.
choice:39:0:1.female: I know exactly what I'm asking.

say:49:1521035034:0.text: You... don't exactly look the part.
say:49:1521035034:0.source_cn: 真的吗……你看起来还没有我的护卫们强壮。
say:49:1521035034:0.male: You... don't exactly look the part.
say:49:1521035034:0.female: You... don't exactly look the part.

choice:39:1:2.text: I can handle myself in a fight.
choice:39:1:2.source_cn: 我有丰富的战斗的经验
choice:39:1:2.male: I can handle myself in a fight.
choice:39:1:2.female: I can handle myself in a fight.

choice:39:2:3.text: I once held off an army. Beasts will be easy.
choice:39:2:3.source_cn: 我连军队都能挡住，更何况几只野兽？
choice:39:2:3.male: I once held off an army. Beasts will be easy.
choice:39:2:3.female: I once held off an army. Beasts will be easy.

choice:23:0:1.text: That's not going to help much.
choice:23:0:1.male: That's not going to help much.
choice:23:0:1.female: That's not going to help much.

say:51:1521035022:0.text: I told you, I have been working on new tactics.
say:51:1521035022:0.source_cn: 我都说了，我读书可是很认真的。

choice:23:1:2.text: I can see you truly wanted to help.
choice:23:1:2.male: I can see you truly wanted to help.
choice:23:1:2.female: I can see you truly wanted to help.

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 珀尔修斯的军队也不听你的？

choice:18:1:2.text: You need Perseus' word for every order?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 为什么不能绕过珀尔修斯？
choice:18:1:2.male: You need Perseus' word for every order?
choice:18:1:2.female: You need Perseus' word for every order?

choice:14:0:1.text: Are you going to ignore the Regulus' command?
choice:14:0:1.male: Are you going to ignore the Regulus' command?
choice:14:0:1.female: Are you going to ignore the Regulus' command?

choice:14:1:2.text: Do you serve the council more than the Regulus?
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 难道议事大臣比领主更可靠？
choice:14:1:2.male: Do you serve the council more than the Regulus?
choice:14:1:2.female: Do you serve the council more than the Regulus?

choice:14:2:3.text: You're acting on the Regulus's orders. No one will give you any trouble.
choice:14:2:3.source_cn: 有领主在，不会有人追责你
choice:14:2:3.male: You're acting on the Regulus's orders. No one will give you any trouble.
